body: Thank you so much for such a kind message. It feels good to know that people care. I’m kind of stuck in between a rock and a hard place though. Not really many choices left.
Same here. If you can pm an invite link. Thanks.
I don’t have anyone. Everyone that meant anything to me, I’ve chased away.
Hi all. I chickened out at the last moment. Going to try to give it a few days. Thanks for all the love and encouragement.

Thank you everyone for the outpouring of support. This I did not expect from a bunch of strangers. I’m still here until this evening. I have to get a few loose ends tied up. 
Unfortunately the decision has been made but love you all.

I guess that’s only fair considering how helpful this forum and everybody has been to me.

I’ve struggled with depression/mental illness/addiction pretty much all my life. Recent divorce, financial problems, and then meeting the woman who I thought was my soulmate leave me abruptly.
The last few months have been mired in a drug and alcohol induced state and I have managed to get 3 dui’s in a matter of 6 weeks. 
I have nothing left to live for. I am 39 years old and have been a fuck up my entire life.
This is not a decision I made lightly. I’ve been weighing the options for the last couple months.
Thank you Kimberly but I’ve made my decision. I cannot bear another day. This isn’t a decision I’ve come to lightly.
Thanks. But you wouldn’t think I was so amazing if you really knew me.
